name: Zola Mabaso
bio:
Zola's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Johannesburg, she initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, but a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked a passion that rerouted her career. She volunteered her skills, quickly proving her aptitude for fabrication and problem-solving. Zola honed her skills working on rally cars before making the move to single-seaters. 

Known for her meticulous approach and ability to work independently, Zola is a valuable asset to the Caterham Academy team. She believes in precision and efficiency, always seeking ways to improve the reliability and performance of the cars she works on. Her ambition drives her to push the boundaries of what's possible, earning her the respect of her peers and the trust of the drivers.

physical.description: Zola is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting years spent hunched over engine components.

quirks: Always listens to house music while welding.
Refuses to use power tools without first calibrating them.
Keeps a detailed notebook of every adjustment she makes to the cars.
